messages.subject: Reversed continuous scale
parts:
Today I found behaviour that felt surprising to me. Is this a bug or a
feature?

Minimum example:

library(ggplot2)
test.data <- data.frame(depth=0:9, response=1:10)

# works as I expected
qplot(response,depth, data=test.data, ylim=c(9,0), geom="smooth")

# this too works as I expected
plot1 <- ggplot(test.data, aes(y = depth)) +
geom_smooth(aes(x = response)) +
ylim(9,0)
print(plot1)

# this fails to draw the curve although the axes are fine
# this was the first thing I tried!
plot1 <- ggplot(test.data, aes(y = depth)) +
geom_smooth(aes(x = response)) +
scale_y_continuous(limits=c(9,0))
print(plot1)

Is this the expected behaviour?
I have been using ggplot2 for only a few weeks.

Pedro.
